edges.reason: msg.sender is written into _owner in the constructor, so ownership is entirely caller-defined
msg.sender supplies the from address when transfer() invokes _transfer
msg.sender is used as the token sender in transfer()
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is reduced in transferFrom()
msg.sender is the approving owner in approve()
onlyOwner compares _owner with msg.sender before setBots runs
onlyOwner gate restricting setBots to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting createPair to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting openTrading to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting manualswap to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting manualsend to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting delBot to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting setRemoveMaxTx to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting _setMaxTxAmount to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting _setSellTax to the owner
onlyOwner gate restricting setBuyTax to the owner
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading
transfer() delegates all transfer logic to _transfer
transferFrom() performs the move through _transfer
transferFrom reads and rewrites the _allowances mapping
approve writes the requested allowance into _allowances
_transfer finishes by routing the transfer through _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer forwards execution to _transferStandard
_transferStandard obtains all amounts from _getValues
_transferStandard credits the team fee through _takeTeam
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee through _reflectFee
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from the sender and adds rTransferAmount to the recipient in _rOwned
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to the contract balance in _rOwned
_reflectFee permanently reduces _rTotal by the fee
_reflectFee increases the accumulated _tFeeTotal
_getValues queries the current reflection rate
_getValues calls _getTValues for the token side amounts
_getValues calls _getRValues for the reflection side amounts
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply
_getCurrentSupply reads the live _rTotal value
_feeAddr1 is passed as the tax fee percentage into _getTValues via _getValues
_feeAddr2 is passed as the team fee percentage into _getTValues via _getValues
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth before _tokenTransfer finalizes the reflection balances, allowing an external call mid-transfer
_transfer sends ETH to the fee address before the token balances are updated
_feeAddress.transfer invokes an arbitrary payable address that can re-enter during the transfer flow
The Uniswap router swap is an external call executed while the swap lock is held and can call back into the token
manualswap swaps the whole contract token balance via swapTokensForEth
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance through sendETHToFee
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call with the whole contract ETH balance
createPair performs an external factory call whose result is stored as the pair
openTrading consumes and approves against the uniswapV2Router state variable
createPair assigns the hardcoded router to the uniswapV2Router state variable
createPair stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair
openTrading enables automatic swaps by setting swapEnabled
openTrading opens trading by setting tradingOpen
openTrading enables the max transaction checks by setting removeMaxTx
openTrading rewrites _maxTxAmount to 1e9 tokens
openTrading rewrites _maxHoldAmount to 2e9 tokens
setRemoveMaxTx toggles the removeMaxTx flag that gates the limits
Owner can raise _maxTxAmount arbitrarily high, weakening the anti-whale protection meant to constrain holders
_setMaxTxAmount also rewrites _maxHoldAmount in the same guarded branch
_setSellTax updates the sell tax used in _transfer
setBuyTax updates the buy tax used in _transfer
_transfer branches on the fee-exclusion map to decide whether taxes and swaps apply
_transfer requires the sender not to be flagged in bots
_transfer reads and triggers the inSwap lock that guards the external calls
_transfer resets _feeAddr1 before the fee calculation
_transfer assigns _feeAddr2 to the buy or sell tax
_transfer compares from and to against uniswapV2Pair
_transfer compares addresses against the router and re-approves it during swaps
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on buys
_transfer enforces the _maxHoldAmount limit on buys
_buyTax value is copied into _feeAddr2 for buy-side transfers
_sellTax value is copied into _feeAddr2 for sell-side transfers
setBots marks every supplied address as a bot in the blacklist
delBot clears the bot flag for the given address
balanceOf reads the reflection balance from _rOwned
balanceOf converts the reflection balance using _getRate
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send block inside _transfer
openTrading grants maximum allowance to the pair contract
_tTotal is the divisor of the supply ratio computation in _getCurrentSupply
rSupply is divided by tSupply in _getRate, the core reflection arithmetic that can round to zero or skew on divergence
amount.add(walletBalance) <= _maxHoldAmount mixes user amount with the current holding, relying on SafeMath to prevent overflow
from parameter is the sender account operated on by _transfer
to parameter is the recipient account operated on by _transfer
amount parameter drives tax, limit and balance computations in _transfer
contractTokenBalance is passed as the token amount to swap
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer()
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer()
sender parameter is the account debited in transferFrom()
recipient parameter is the account credited in transferFrom()
amount parameter is both transferred and deducted from the allowance
spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve()
amount parameter is the allowance value written by approve()
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth
path array is supplied to the router swap call
amount parameter is the ETH value sent to the fee address
bots_ array supplies the addresses inserted into the blacklist
loop index i controls iteration over the blacklist array
notbot parameter is the address whose bot flag is cleared
sender parameter is the account debited in _transferStandard
recipient parameter is the account credited in _transferStandard
tAmount parameter is decomposed into fee and transfer amounts
rAmount local variable is subtracted from the sender reflection balance
tTeam parameter is converted to a reflection amount and credited to the contract
rFee parameter is subtracted from _rTotal
tFee parameter is added to the accumulated fee total
tAmount parameter is the base value for all _getValues computations
maxTxAmount parameter becomes the new transaction cap
maxHoldAmount parameter becomes the new holding cap
sellTax parameter is validated and written to _sellTax
buyTax parameter is validated and written to _buyTax
onoff parameter is written into the removeMaxTx flag
rSupply local variable participates in the supply comparison and division feeding _getRate
contractBalance local variable is swapped by manualswap
contractETHBalance local variable is forwarded by manualsend
taxFee percentage is multiplied by the amount and divided by 100 inside _getTValues
TeamFee percentage is multiplied by the amount and divided by 100 inside _getTValues
